Dry 50 C for 8 h.
Manufacturer max speed 300 mm/s.

Shop correction 2026-10-11: values from the spool label (220-260 C, bed 60-80 C, fan 50%), because the product page's 190-260 C / bed 45 C reads like PLA copy. Max speed kept at the page's 300 mm/s (label: 30-600). Product page spec block: recommended printing temperature 190-260C, heating bed 45C (single value), 50-300 mm/s, 1.75+/-0.05 mm; tensile 40-50 MPa, elongation 6-10%, E-modulus 3100-3500 MPa, impact 35-55 kJ/m2. Page tip: dry 50C for 8 h in a Creality dryer (recorded). BIG CONFLICT with the spool label: 220-260C, bed 60-80C, 30-600 mm/s, fan 50% - the label values are far more typical for PETG; page values recorded per convention, consider the label for profiles. fan_pct 50 from label; K2 Plus profile 240C/70C bed, fan 40/80%, 23 mm3/s, retraction 1.2 mm. Creality wiki generic PETG drying: 60C 8-12 h. CFS-C: retraction must be tuned manually.
